name: minusone
description: MCP server for reverse engineering: 71 semantic operations for static triage, unpacking, decompilation (Ghidra/IDA), dynamic instrumentation (frida, TTD), emulation (Unicorn), symbolic execution (angr), and evidence handling — for any MCP-compatible agent host.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs test/combat.e2e.mjs
scripts.doctor: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli/main.js doctor
scripts.analyze: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli/main.js analyze
scripts.mcp-check: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli/main.js mcp-check
scripts.chat: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli/main.js chat
scripts.providers:build: docker build -f docker/capa.Dockerfile -t minusone/capa:9.4.0 . && docker build -f docker/yarax.Dockerfile -t minusone/yara-x:1.19.0 . && docker build -f docker/floss.Dockerfile -t minusone/floss:3.1.1 . && docker build -f docker/die.Dockerfile -t minusone/die:3.21 . && docker build -f docker/volatility3.Dockerfile -t minusone/volatility3:2.28.0 .
